svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 04 / TETRIS
svg.desc: 27,531 GitHub contributions across 175 active days, 2025-11-16 to 2026-11-21. Active dates supply legal tetrominoes, with lower contribution counts first. The board has the original calendar width and seven weekday rows. Missing dates are unavailable. Pieces collide with the stack, full weekday lines clear, and cleared calendar tiles disappear with the piece outlines. If no legal piece fits, the calendar rests.

g.text: 175 planned date pieces · 0 restarts · 0 without drop space
Complete a line to clear its calendar tiles.
